description: Create a workflow template with ordered steps. Steps can be: task (agent executes via council), wait (pause), condition (evaluate), branch (diverge), notify (alert). Triggers: schedule (cron), event, manual, webhook.

steps.description: Ordered array of { type, config } objects. Max 20 steps.

triggerConfig.description: Trigger config: { cron: "0 6 * * *" } for schedule, etc.

triggerType.description: schedule, event, manual, or webhook (default: manual)

name: create_workflow
